    best=None

        vv=sum(1 for j in range(W) if sum(r[j]==c for r in inp)>=H*0.9)
        score=hh+vv

import inspect
def f(inp):
    H,W=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    dd,fc=Counter(v for r in inp for v in r).most_common(2)[1][0],Counter(v for r in inp for v in r).most_common(2)[0][0]
    mr=sorted({i for i,r in enumerate(inp) if any(v not in (dd,fc) for v in r)})
    mc=sorted({j for j in range(W) if any(inp[i][j] not in (dd,fc) for i in mr)})
    cr=[i for i in range(H) if sum(x==dd for x in inp[i])>=W*0.5 and min(mr)<=i<=max(mr)]
    cl=[j for j in range(W) if sum(r[j]==dd for r in inp)>=H*0.5 and min(mc)<=j<=max(mc)]
    out=[[fc]*(len(cl)-1) for _ in range(len(cr)-1)]
    for bi in range(len(cr)-1):
        for bj in range(len(cl)-1):
            cs=[inp[cr[bi]][cl[bj]],inp[cr[bi]][cl[bj+1]],inp[cr[bi+1]][cl[bj]],inp[cr[bi+1]][cl[bj+1]]]
            if len(set(cs))==1 and cs[0]!=dd: out[bi][bj]=cs[0]
    return out
